scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @fluxia/shared" "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fluxia/shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fluxia/shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
